A teenager whose parents forgot her birthday searches for the man of her dreams. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald and Justin Henry.
A rivalry comes about between two best friends when they each schedule their respective weddings on the same day.
A rich businessman and his daughter become the target of scheming tycoons, terrorists and assassins. Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
A musician wakes up after being hit by a bus to find he is the only person in the world who remembers the Beatles. Comedy, with Himesh Patel and Lily James. Directed by Danny Boyle.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.
A dim male model's career starts to decline and he fails to realise he is a pawn in a dangerous game of international espionage. Comedy, starring Ben Stiller and Owen Wilson.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished. Trying to help some teenagers, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now David's in big debt to his supplier, and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.
A dim-witted supermodel must step back into the spotlight when a maniac starts murdering some of the world's most beautiful pop stars. Comedy sequel, starring Ben Stiller.

Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.
Two lifelong best friends become bitter rivals when their weddings are scheduled to take place on the same day and at the same venue. Comedy, starring Kate Hudson and Anne Hathaway.
A teenager whose parents forgot her birthday searches for the man of her dreams. Comedy drama, starring Molly Ringwald and Justin Henry.

When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high-school students, trading in their guns and badges for backpacks, and setting out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.
An undercover cop poses as a preschool teacher to catch a drug dealer whose son is one of the pupils in his class. Comedy, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Penelope Ann Miller.
Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.
Asked to be maid of honour, the best friend of a bride must suddenly face off with an alpha bridesmaid, a woman who clearly wants to take over her job and her best friend status.

An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami 🏈 [NFL] Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.
A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.

Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.
Dubbed the 'Grindr Killer', serial rapist Stephen Port murdered at least four men between 2014 and 2015 by using a variety of online gay social networks to find his victims.
A young mother is murdered in front of her child. Detectives hunt a mysterious suspect, only to uncover a bizarre disguise and a shocking twist.
After Marique Ruth claims she shot boyfriend John Killen in self-defence, forensic evidence and chilling bodycam footage cast doubt on her story.
When a young girl is murdered yards from home and her justice denied, one family's fight to expose the truth sends shockwaves through a community.
A computer at Vogue magazine held the key to identifying Julie Clayton, a former member of the 'Jesus Army' murdered just before she planned to return home to Australia from the UK.
One passenger appears to be carrying a handgun in their suitcase, and another passenger's bag gets swabbed and tests positive for traces of drugs.
A driver on the run from police crashes into a stop sign and risks a head-on collision with a bus, and the question remains whether he will escape both the police and a serious smash.
An overturned tractor urgently needs a Helivac. Flooding hits the Tasman region and travellers are cut off by rising waters.
A truckie's seatbelt and safe driving save his neck when a tyre blows, and a cellphone spotting exercise uncovers far too many drivers typing and swiping.

A breakdown blocks a lane, leading to a crash in the queue, there is a data disaster when a paper trail is left blowing in the wind, and it's horses for courses as traffic cops deal with a stranded pony.
Mike and Chris chase a drug dealer on the M5 motorway, Daryl and Murphy from Exeter search for a group of young men who crash a stolen car, and tactical aid prepares for a raid.
From epic wipe-outs to scandalous scammers, height restriction mishaps and pedantic pedestrians, it's all caught on dashcam.
From the terrors of night driving to perfect family pranks, dicey weather for drivers and parking headaches, it's all caught on dashcam.
In West Wales, an armed response unit gets called to a dangerous domestic incident, and traffic officers have a change of scenery as they combat vandals terrorising walkers in the mountains.
Dom Littlewood looks at clever new methods that the police and the public are using to catch crooks red-handed.
Dom Littlewood looks at clever new methods that the police and the public are using to catch crooks red-handed.
A violent attack on a small village store has a twist in the tale, and two good Samaritans come to the aid of a woman when a handbag snatcher targets her.
Buckle up for shocking crashes, miraculous escapes and COVID nightmares from all four corners of the globe, all caught on camera.
Police investigators look for the perpetrator of a disturbing crime against a vulnerable woman when the body of Nicola Stephenson is found in a wheelie bin near where she lived in Lewes.

After his body was found in his Rothienorman cottage, handyman Brian McKandie's death in 2016 was initially deemed accidental, but a pathologist soon discovered severe injuries that pointed to murder.
A profile of the serial killer known as 'The Gainesville Ripper', who murdered five college students in Gainesville, Florida, creating crime scenes so horrific that he inspired the movie 'Scream'.

pr.t: Murder in Slow Motion: The Shana Grice Story
pr.d: The story of 18-year-old Shana Grice, who was murdered in 2016 by her ex-boyfriend in her East Sussex home after she had endured months of persistent and terrifying stalking.
When the much-loved grandmother Maire Rankin is found murdered on Christmas Day in 2008, suspicion falls on relatives and neighbours as police investigators seek to find the killer.
After Marique Ruth claims she shot boyfriend John Killen in self-defence, forensic evidence and chilling bodycam footage cast doubt on her story.
When a young girl is murdered yards from home and her justice denied, one family's fight to expose the truth sends shockwaves through a community.
The daughter of one of the most dangerous women in Britain reveals how her mother's brutal murder spree, which claimed three victims in March 2013, has affected her own life.

Escaping postwar Europe, a visionary architect comes to America to rebuild his life, his career, and his marriage. On his own in a strange new country, he settles in Pennsylvania, where a wealthy and prominent industrialist recognises his talent.

William Popper (Michael Sarrazin) is a wealthy, shiftless college student at Columbia who, one night in a rainstorm, accidentally kills a jaywalker with his car. Sentenced to a year in prison for manslaughter, William begins serving his term, but before it's finished he decides to break out. With the help of his faithful and politically radical girlfriend, Jane (Barbara Hershey), he skips town and escapes to Canada, where the two are obliged to live like fugitives.
A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.

A young female welder dreams of becoming a professional dancer and struggles against all the odds to realise her dream. However, in her effort to succeed, she discovers that getting to the top is far from easy. Giorgio Moroder's composition 'Flashdance (What a Feeling)', sung by Irene Cara, won an Academy Award for Best Original Song.
The story behind the Veuve Clicquot champagne family and business that began in the late 18th century.

An opera star arrives at a performers' retirement home amidst fraught preparations for a fundraising concert. Her presence adds to the tension, but it also offers an opportunity to reunite a successful quartet.

Following a man's bid for survival on a desert island following a plane crash. An employee of FedEx snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.
After an ambitious manager gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost.
The story of photographer Elizabeth 'Lee' Miller, a fashion model who became an acclaimed war correspondent for Vogue magazine during World War II.
Following a group of Los Angeles residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.

In the 1970s, a 15-year-old boy gets the chance to live out his dream of touring with a band as a rock journalist. The son of a loving but strict single parent, the boy rebels against her distrust of rock music and the surrounding drug culture by writing album reviews which attract sponsorship from a big magazine to tour with a band. Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.

Colin, a timid man, meets Ray, a confident biker gang leader, who initiates him into a submissive relationship, challenging Colin's mundane existence and prompting personal growth through their unconventional dynamic.

When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.
In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her world.
A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.
Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

pr.t: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
pr.d: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.
On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

pr.t: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
pr.d: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.
A 10-year-old girl, Queen Elizabeth II and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.
Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.
While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.

A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.
A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.

Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.
While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.

Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.

Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.

After the IMF are implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, Ethan Hunt and his new team go rogue. In order to clear their organisation's name, they track down a dangerous terrorist named Kurt Hendricks. Hendricks has gained access to Russian nuclear launch codes and is planning a strike on the United States, but will the new team be able to stop the impending disaster?

Secret agents suspect there is a traitor in their organisation when their latest assignment ends in disaster. The sole survivor is accused of being the mole, forcing him to go on the run to clear his name. However, in the process, he discovers a former Russian spy is selling information about the world's leading undercover operatives. Action thriller based on the 1960s TV series, starring Tom Crui

Ethan Hunt and his team take on their most impossible mission yet to eradicate the Syndicate -- a highly skilled, international organisation dedicated to creating a new world order via a series of terrorist attacks.

Secret agent Ethan Hunt is sent to find and destroy the only sample of a deadly man-made virus. However, he faces tough opposition in a former spy-turned-criminal mastermind who has already acquired the cure and now wants the pathogen itself. Director John Woo's action thriller sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Dougray Scott, Thandiwe Newton and Anthony Hopkins.

Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

Former secret agent Ethan Hunt is called out of retirement when an ex-trainee is taken hostage by a ruthless arms dealer, but when the rescue operation goes wrong, the villain decides to target Hunt's fiancee. Action thriller sequel directed by JJ Abrams, starring Tom Cruise, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Michelle Monaghan, Ving Rhames and Simon Pegg.

The spies plan to clear their name by abducting the real terrorist, which leads them into a pursuit around the globe. However, Hunt cannot be sure his colleagues are trustworthy. Action adventure sequel, starring Tom Cruise, Jeremy Renner, Simon Pegg and Paula

Now a trainer for IMF recruits, superspy Ethan Hunt is called back to active duty to confront the toughest foe he has ever faced: Owen Davian, an international broker of arms and information who is as cunning as he is ruthless. As Ethan searches for the missing agent, Davian emerges to threaten him and all that he holds dear, including the woman that he loves.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

pr.t: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
pr.d: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a 🏈🐻 [NFL] Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.

Two brothers and their adult children head to Ireland to honour their late father's final wish by scattering his ashes on a golf course. What starts as a clash of egos, old grudges and comic misadventures soon turns into a week of bonding and warmth.

A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.
Two aquatic misfits embark on an impossible journey to save their home.
Years after a college newsroom mishap sent Meg and Billy down opposite life paths, they reunite in a small Texas town to save an annual holiday event.

Trapped in a cosy cabin by a blizzard, two couples ring in the new year with a mysterious cocktail that strips away their inhibitions, turning their romantic getaway into a showdown of secrets, betrayals and rapidly shifting loyalties.
When a cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and drops it into the unknown, the Platt family soon discover that their survival depends on sticking together in an alien landscape.

Supernatural comedy about three New York parapsychology professors who decide to set up a ghost-catching agency. Soon a storm of malevolent spirits threatens to destroy the city, and the mysterious contents of a woman's fridge suggest a paranormal Armageddon.

The phantom-fighters return to the streets of New York when they come to the aid of a woman who fears that her baby is the target of ghostly forces. Four years after Dr Peter Venkman broke up with Dana Barrett, she appeals for help to save her son when an arch-demon trapped in an oil painting wants to take over his body. The old team reunite and trace the source of the trouble to a sinister underground river of slime.

A party of high school students settle in a woodland cabin for the weekend. When they find and read a copy of 'The Book of the Dead', a tome that raises not just demons outside the walls but within, they become demonically possessed with murderous desires.
This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about Killers. From 'Scream 7' to 'The Conjuring: Last Rites', prepare for blood-curdling sequels and some seriously sinister scares.
A ragtag band of humans bands together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea.

pr.t: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
pr.d: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.
After an act of terrorism against Starfleet leaves him with a personal score to settle, Captain Kirk leads the Enterprise on a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City.

Sequel to the sci-fi comedy about a top-secret government task force set up to deal with unruly extraterrestrials. An MIB agent turns to the only man who can help him save the world from a rampaging, shape-shifting alien which has taken on the outward appearance of a sexy lingerie model.
Agent J goes back to the swinging 60s in a time-travelling mission to save his partner from a murderous alien.
After an act of terrorism against Starfleet leaves him with a personal score to settle, Captain Kirk leads the Enterprise on a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

Columbus and Tallahassee have orchestrated a way to survive a world overrun by zombies. With only fear keeping the `big wuss' Columbus alive, Tallahassee wants to eradicate the `last Twinkie on Earth'. The duo join forces with Wichita and Little Rock who have a style and tact of their own when it comes to dealing with the flesh-eating chaos.
The pupils of St Bernadette's must save the day when teacher Martin Clunes gets kicked by a nativity donkey and loses his memory. Family sequel.

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.
Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis cause uproar in their Christmas-crazy suburb when they give the festivities a miss. Dingdong comedy, based on a John Grisham story.
Santa's oversized helper Will Ferrell goes to New York to find his real dad, only to discover he's a mean old grouch. Hit comedy with Zooey Deschanel.
Three ghosts give a greedy network executive a long-overdue attitude adjustment over the Christmas period. Based on the Charles Dickens classic, 'A Christmas Carol'.
Santa's clumsy son Arthur must save the day when his dad's present delivery system misses someone out. Festive animation with the voices of James McAvoy and Bill Nighy.

Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. However, on arrival they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer, to put on a show.
An uptight teacher's lie about Hollywood watching his class's nativity play spreads through his struggling school, boosting everyone's self-esteem. Festive heart warmer.

A musician who neglects his family in pursuit of his career is tragically killed in a car accident, but is given a second chance to get back into his son's life when he is reincarnated as a snowman.
Santa's oversized helper Will Ferrell goes to New York to find his real dad, only to discover he's a mean old grouch. Hit comedy with Zooey Deschanel.
Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis cause uproar in their Christmas-crazy suburb when they give the festivities a miss. Dingdong comedy, based on a John Grisham story.

An anxious teacher starts a new job at an under-achieving school and quickly finds himself struggling to cope with a wild classroom assistant, a group of under-performing kids and his own very pregnant wife.
The pupils at St Bernadette's primary school are on their best behaviour for the arrival of strict new teacher Mr Shepherd. But when he loses his memory, it's up to the kids to save the day.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

Weaving in and out of the love lives of eight loosely inter-related couples. The bachelor Prime Minister falls for his personal assistant, his brother-in-law is flirting with one of his colleagues, a writer heads off to France and pursues an affair with a maid, and an 11-year-old boy asks his father for advice on matters of the heart.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.

Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

As rioting and civil unrest rocks Detroit during the summer of 1967, several policemen begin interrogating guests at the Algiers Motel. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

pr.t: I'm a Celebrity - How to Survive the Jungle
pr.d: Ant and Dec present hints and tongue-in-cheek tips for celebrities to help survive not only the jungle and camp life, but also campmates and their assortment of annoying habits. They also revisit some of the most memorable moments in the programme's history, drawing on a quarter of a century of terrifying trials and camp chaos to arm the next bunch of unsuspecting celebrities with an arsenal of must-have jungle hacks

Spain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Ga

Mass accommodation sites are central to the Government's plan to end the use of asylum hotels and this undercover investigation goes inside Crowborough, a former military training camp in East Sussex now housing asylum seekers. The programme investigates conditions inside the site, finding how systemically poor welfare checks are having serious consequences, and also examines the local community's response to asylum seekers being housed in the town

pr.t: Mein Leben mit 300 kg: Die Videotagebücher
pr.d: Grace ist erst 26 Jahre alt, doch ihr extremes Übergewicht bedroht schon ihr Leben. Mit fast 300 Kilo leidet sie unter Atemnot, Bluthochdruck und massiven Bewegungseinschränkungen. Der Weihnachtsmann lädt zum Weihnachts-Dankfest ein, das alle hundert Jahre stattfindet. Väterchen Frost, die Lichterkönigin Luccia, die Hexe Roxana und die Sternenstaub-Streuerin sind mit von der Partie. Der Weihnachtsmann zaubert mitten am Nordpol einen Strand und ein leckeres Büfett herbei. Grantelbart bekommt von der Feier Wind und ist erbost, weil er nicht eingeladen ist.

Torg und Zilka, zwei Kinder aus dem fernen Scomland, in dem es keine Elfen gibt, wollen gerne mehr über die geheimnisvollen Wesen wissen. Trixi, Gilfi und Jordi entwerfen ein elektronisches 3D-Buch für die Kinder und lassen es von der Spielzeug-Maschine herstellen. Leider sabotieren Grantelbart und Gugor ihr Vorhaben.

Gugor leidet unter Grantelbarts Gemeinheiten und wünscht sich einen mechanischen Doppelgänger, der all seine Aufgaben übernimmt. Obwohl der Weihnachtsmann zustimmen müsste, bauen Jordi und Trixi aus Mitgefühl vor Heiligabend einen eigenen Roboter.

Jordi baut einen Teleporter, mit dem man alles und jeden von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren kann. Er überredet die anderen Elfen und den Weihnachtsmann zu einer Testfahrt. Grantelbart, der das Geschehen beobachtet hat, manipuliert den Teleporter, der auch als Zeitmaschine dient, und die Freunde landen im Jahr 2222.

Frau Strengelmeier plant, ihre alten Spiele zu verkaufen, wird jedoch von einem alten Freund sowie Mats und Malika davon abgehalten. Sie alle werden durch einen Trick in die Welt eines Spiels gezogen und erleben ein gefährliches Abenteuer.

Nach einer Erklärung an Emilie und Maurice über Frau Strengelmeiers Abwesenheit holen sich die Freunde neue Würfel bei Niels im Spieleladen. Gemeinsam betreten sie die Spielewelt, um Frau Strengelmeier vor Robin zu retten.

Zwei Walküren identifizieren Suzy als ihre verlorene Schwester und bringen sie nach Asgard, um ihr Schicksal als Kriegerin zu erfüllen. Mats und Malika realisieren, dass sie Suzy helfen müssen und machen sich gemeinsam auf den Weg.

Mats und Malika werden in Haustiere verwandelt und begegnen Ajax, der glaubt, ausgesetzt worden zu sein. Er plant mit Zerberus einen Aufstand gegen die Menschen. Doch dann stellt sich heraus, dass er aus Eifersucht geflohen ist.

Tristan soll für die Entführung von Flora, der Prinzessin des Baumvolks, verurteilt werden. Die Kinder wollen Tristans Unschuld beweisen. Dann stellt sich heraus, dass Tristan Floras große Liebe ist, deren Beziehung jedoch geheimgehalten werden muss.

Malika leidet unter Lampenfieber und hat Schwierigkeiten, ihren Vortrag zu üben. Sie verhaspelt sich immer wieder. Mats schlägt vor, dass sie mit einem Profi üben sollte, um ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern. Daraufhin wird die Handpuppe ihr Lehrer.

Mats und Malika erfahren von Adele, dass der Brunnen im Park ein Jungbrunnen ist, der Menschen verjüngt. Neugierig probieren sie das Wasser aus und verwandeln sich in Kleinkinder und danach in Babys. In Panik suchen sie nach einem Gegenmittel.

Mats und Malika begegnen Pandora, die von Zeus geschickt wurde, um menschliche Schwächen zu beseitigen. Während Mats von seiner Unpünktlichkeit geheilt wird, entkommt Malika Pandoras Einfluss und erkennt den Wert menschlicher Schwächen.

Mats findet Cowboystiefel mit der gefangenen Seele des Cowboys Sullivan, der noch unerledigte Aufgaben hat. Sullivan übernimmt Mats Körper und bittet Malika um Unterstützung, um seine Liste abzuarbeiten und Frieden zu finden.

Malika bringt ihren kleinen Bruder Bilel zu dem Babysitter Gustav, doch dieser entrümpelt gerade das Hexenhaus. In dem Chaos findet Bilel ein magisches Zepter und zaubert damit herum. Malika will ihn beschützen, doch das ist alles andere als einfach.

Die Sphinx, die nur in Rätseln spricht, bittet Oscar und Malika um Hilfe. Sie verstehen in etwa, dass sie solche Angst hat, bei ihrer Prüfung für den Eintritt in die andere Welt zu versagen, dass sie nicht erschienen ist, und deshalb bestraft wurde.

Grizzly hat sich etwas zu essen vorbereitet und will nun bei seiner Lieblingssendung speisen. Doch kaum sitzt er vor dem Fernseher, ist das Bild nicht klar. Schnell entdeckt der Bär, warum das Bild dauernd wackelt: Die Lemminge nutzen die Fernsehantenne als Sprungbrett für ihre Wasserspiele.

Die Lemminge feiern eine wilde Party. Als Grizzly ihre Musikanlage in den Fluss wirft, sorgt er damit für einen Stromausfall. Wenn er keine alternative Energiequelle findet, kann er seinen gemütlichen Fernsehabend vergessen.

Grizzy erfährt, dass die Bärendame den Geruch von Blumen liebt. Aus diesem Grund will er ihr die Geranien schenken, die die Fensterbänke der Hütte des Waldaufsehers schmücken. Nun muss er es schaffen, ihr die Blumen zu bringen, bevor die Lemminge ihm den Plan zunichtemachen.

Das ist definitiv nicht Grizzys Tag: Nachdem er sich vor der Bärendame blamiert hat, in die er unsterblich verliebt ist, wird er auch noch von den Lemmingen, die in absoluter Topform sind, aus dem Haus des Försters ausgesperrt. Grizzy landet schließlich in einem Feld voller Kleeblätter und entdeckt ein vierblättriges, das ihm allem Anschein nach endlich Glück bringt.

Grizzly traut seinen Augen kaum, als er sieht, wie sich in seiner Umgebung scheinbar wie von Geisterhand plötzlich alle möglichen Gegenstände bewegen. Doch als er begreift, dass die Lemminge mit einem besonders starken Magneten experimentieren, kommt ihm ein genialer Gedanke: Er wird einen telekinetischen Trick ausarbeiten und so seine heiß geliebte Bärendame beeindrucken.

Nach einem kleinen Missverständnis ist Grizzly der festen Überzeugung, dass sich die Bärendame, in die er sich verliebt hat, in einen Frosch verwandelt hat. Verzweifelt blättert er durch die Märchenbücher des Försters und sucht nach einer Möglichkeit, die Bärendame in ihre normale Gestalt zurückzuverwandeln. Die Lemminge sind indes auf der Suche nach dem Frosch, mit dem sie so viel Spaß hatten.

Auf der Spielekonsole des Försters entdeckt Grizzly zufällig, wie viel Spaß Videospiele machen können. Auch die Lemminge wollen mitspielen, doch Grizzly weigert sich vehement, sein Autorennspiel zu unterbrechen. Obwohl die Lemminge daraufhin alles versuchen, um Grizzly von der Spielekonsole wegzulocken, haben sie keine Chance: Grizzly ist süchtig nach Videospielen.
Die Lemminge lassen Grizzly mal wieder nicht schlafen: Sie haben Feuerwerk aufgetrieben, mit dem sie Schabernack treiben und auf der Chinesischen Mauer hin und her düsen wie auf einer Achterbahn.

Grizzy und die Lemminge streiten sich um das letzte Glas Yummy-Schokoladenaufstrich, welches natürlich versehentlich im Meer landet. Während sich der Bär eine Taucherausrüstung aus der Einrichtung der Hütte bastelt, nutzen die Lemminge ein kleines Aquarium und Sauerstofftank, um ihrem Gegenspieler zuvorzukommen. Unter Wasser müssen sie sich dann aber auch noch mit den wilden Tieren auseinandersetzen.

Grizzly zerstört aus Versehen sein Sofa und den Fernseher. Auf einer Nachbarinsel sieht er eine Hütte, aus der er hofft, Ersatz besorgen zu können. Dafür kapert er das Boot, mit dem die Lemminge gerade herumdüsen, aber muss entdecken, dass es nichts zu holen gibt. Dafür dockt an der Insel eine luxuriöse Yacht, um die sich natürlich Bär und Lemminge kabbeln ...

Die Lemminge gehen Grizzly, der ein Nickerchen machen will, mal wieder auf den Senkel. Die Auseinandersetzung führt mal wieder an den Vulkan, wo die Lemminge wieder ein magisches Zepter finden - diesmal kontrolliert es das Feuer, und sie haben einen Riesenspaß mit einer Art Lava-Achterbahn quer über die Insel. Diesmal kann Grizzly den kleinen Nagern nicht trotzen - oder doch?

Grizzy und die Lemminge beobachten, wie ein Helikopter die Insel verlässt und finden ein zurückgelassenes Set einer Gameshow. Um an das Essen zu kommen, das sich unter einer Glaskuppel befindet, müssen sie am Wettbewerb teilnehmen und sich drei Schlüssel verdienen. Die Lemminge bilden das gelbe Team und das rote Team besteht aus Grizzy, einer Krabbe und einem Ruder mit aufgemaltem Gesicht.

Michael Portillo crosses the county line from Devon into Somerset on his rail exploration of the West Country steered by his 1930s Bradshaw's guide. He sees first-hand how willow farmers sought to overcome the challenge from the production of synthetic plastics during the 1930s. He hears how tourism for all budgets spread across the region.
Michael explores Hackney Wick, today transformed from the time of his 1930s Bradshaw's guide, when factories belched smoke and the Communist Party of Great Britain launched 'The Daily Worker'.

Beginning in Canterbury in Kent, Michael treads the boards as he uncovers the political message behind a play, published in 1936, inspired by the 12th century murder of Archbishop Thomas a Becket. In Maidstone, he learns of the international origins of the most British symbol of remembrance before paying his respects at a war memorial based on London's Cenotaph.

Michael's Bradshaw's-inspired rail tour of London continues in Hampstead, where shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War, a groundbreaking Jewish doctor found refuge. Sigmund Freud fled Vienna by train to escape the Nazis.

In Lawrence, Kansas, Michael joins the Jayhawks basketball team before travelling through Tornado Alley to Topeka to meet one of the first storm chasers in America. Driving out on the Great Plains, Michael comes face to face with a herd of buffalo.

Martin Clunes examines the role of the world's working horses as he begins training his own beloved Clydesdales, Ronnie and Bruce, and puts them through their paces on his Dorset farm. Martin has had the pair for two years, but they still have much to learn as they are sent away to expert trainer Robert Sampson to be instructed in the art of cart-pulling.

pr.t: Martin Clunes: The Lemurs of Madagascar
pr.d: Martin Clunes travels to the island of Madagascar to investigate the fate of the world's last surviving lemurs. Lemurs live only on this beautiful island and are disappearing. Martin meets those who are trying to protect lemurs from extinction and, although he is saddened by what he sees of the destruction of the lemurs' natural habitat, he is inspired by the dedicated work of the conservationists.
Martin travels to Berenty Reserve in Madagascar, home to six species of lemur, and discovers the crucial role that local guides and volunteers play in protecting the wildlife.
Sir David hears about Sir George Cayley and Percy Pilcher as he looks at the British inventors who played a part in the evolution of flight.

Sir David gets behind the controls of a tank as he finds out about the British inventors who gave us some of the most extreme machines on the planet. In Liverpool, he operates one of the world's biggest hydraulic cranes.

The last leg of Simon Reeve's journey begins on the northern tip of Sumatra, near the epicentre of the 2004 tsunami, and takes him to the south-western corner of Australia. In Banda Aceh, Sharia law is in force and Simon joins the local vice and virtue squad who patrol the streets and beaches. In the Indonesian capital of Jakarta, Simon investigates the shocking trade in exotic pets.

Simon travels to an unspoilt corner of Greenland that could become one of the biggest uranium mines in the world, while Kate follows the oil money that's shaped Alaska. In Churchill, Gordon learns how to stay safe when living side by side with the world's largest living land carnivore.
Life on board a narrowboat with Robbie Cumming. There are engine issues and a leaky boat to fix before Robbie reaches Liverpool Docks.

Butters kommt auf die Idee, E-Zigaretten zusammen mit dem Zubehör an der Schule zu verkaufen. Außerdem muss Randy derweil mit seiner Familie aufs Land ziehen. Dort probiert er erstmals die Tätigkeiten eines Farmers nachzugehen.

In dieser Episode ist Mr. Mackey dabei, sich auf den Kalten Krieg vorzubereiten. Dabei organisiert er ununterbrochene Übungen für einen möglichen nuklearen Notfall und beantragt zudem die Finanzierung eines neuen Bunkers.
Kurz vor dem Untergang von South Park kehrt Jesus mit einer wichtigen Botschaft zurück.

Als die Organisation ICE die hispanischen Arbeiter von Randy Marsh in Haft nimmt, bleibt ihm nur noch Towlie als Mitarbeiter übrig. Gemeinsam müssen sie jetzt kreativ werden, um ihr Geschäft immer noch am Laufen zu halten.
Kyle und Cartman geraten in Zwist, als eine Prognosemarkt-App bei ihren Mitschülern populär wird.
Cartman wird vom Teufel besessen und könnte die einzige Hoffnung sein, den Antichristen aufzuhalten.
Tina übernimmt als ganz neue Kummerkastentante die Ratgeberkolumne der Schulzeitung.
Mr. Fischoeder darf endlich seine Lieblingssinfonie dirigieren. Doch Bob gerät zwischen die Fronten.
Linda zwingt alle zu einem Familienspaziergang. Die Kinder stoßen auf eine Verschwörungstheorie.
Tina, Gene und Louise machen mit ihrem illegalen Snackverkauf an der Schule großen Reibach.
Tina wird mit etwas konfrontiert, das noch beängstigender ist als ihr Erzfeind Trupp 257.

Als Stans Schwiegersohn Jeff herausfindet, dass Roger ein Alien ist, steht Stan vor einer schweren Entscheidung. Um das Geheimnis zu bewahren und seine Familie vor der CIA zu beschützen, muss entweder Jeff oder Roger verschwinden.

Stan Smith muss, wie James Bond, einen Bösewicht jagen, der einen teuflischen Plan ausheckt. Der Black Villain möchte den Nordpol schmelzen, um eine große Flutwelle zu erzeugen. Stan muss alles daran setzen, seinen Plan zu durchkreuzen.

Als Francine beobachtet, wie Hiko ihre Tochter Akiko fördert, um sie auf ein Elite-College zu schicken, möchte sie das gleiche für Steve erreichen. Doch dieser ist nur im Buchstabieren begabt und es kommt zum Wettstreit zwischen Steve und Akiko.

Weil seine Frau von dem ehelichen Beischlaf gelangweilt ist und er ihre Vorlieben für unreligiös hält, verbannt Stan sie in einen Wald. Doch als Roger Stan in die Welt der Fetische einführt, ist dieser begeistert und bereit, Neues auszuprobieren.
Malcolms Mutter hält Augen und Ohren offen, und so bleibt keiner der Streiche, die Malcolm und seine Brüder aushecken, unentdeckt.

Malcolm ist überglücklich, denn Vater hat endlich Karten für den Wasserrutschen-Park besorgt. Doch dummerweise erinnert Reese Mutter daran, dass Malcolm Schnupfen hat und besser eine Nasenklammer tragen sollte.

Als Malcolm, Reese, Lois und Hal vom Wasserpark nach Hause fahren, wird die Straße wegen eines Verkehrsunfalls gesperrt. Nun muss die Familie bei über dreißig Grad mit mehreren anderen hundert Autos im Stau ausharren.
Francis verspricht seinen Brüdern einen Riesenstreich für Halloween. Lois und Hal stehlen derweil das Auto eines Rasers, um ihn aus dem Verkehr zu ziehen.
Damit Lois dieses Jahr von ihren Söhnen etwas zum Geburtstag bekommt, gibt sie jedem 10 Dollar. Leider endet dies in einem Desaster und Hal vergisst ihren Geburtstag ganz und gar.
Eric erzählt von einer großen Veränderung, nach einer Nahtoderfahrung über Weihnachten.
Petes Ex-Frau Carol taucht während Sams und Jays Halloween-Party in Woodstone Mansion auf.
Ein Investor zieht sich aus Sams und Jays Restaurant zurück und sie treffen auf einen reichen Geist.

Gloria lernt für ihren Einbürgerungstest. Mitch und Cam nehmen an einem Protest gegen ein lokales Restaurant teil. Alex erfährt, dass sie sich den Abschiedsrednerposten teilen soll. Der Schulleiter will die Entscheidung nach einem Wettrennen fällen.

Claire erhält ein Jobangebot von einer Hotelkette und hadert mit der Entscheidung, Jays Firma zu verlassen. Gloria nutzt Mannys Zustand nach einer Weisheitszahn-OP aus. Phil, Luke und Haley zwingen Alex dazu, den "Senior Ditch Day" zu feiern.

Alex hat ihren Highschool-Abschluss in der Tasche und will mit ihrer Familie feiern. Phil kann leider nicht dabei sein, da er sich auf einer Dienstreise eine Ohrenentzündung zugezogen hat und nicht fliegen darf. Andy schaltet ihn via Skype hinzu.
Haley und Andy beschäftigen sich auf unterschiedliche Weise mit ihren Emotionen.
Phil und Claire sind verletzt, als Alex lügt, was ihr Collegeeinzugsdatum angeht.

Jeff wurde von Aliens entführt und muss für sie als Sklave arbeiten. Der einzige Weg, auf die Erde zurückzukehren, scheint ein Test des Imperators zu sein, in welchem Jeff seine aufrichtige Liebe zu Hayley beweisen muss.

Der Goldfisch Klaus war früher ein deutscher Skispringer, doch dank der CIA ist er in dem Körper des Fischs gefangen. Als er die Möglichkeit hat, tauscht er seinen Körper mit Stan und macht sich auf den Weg zum Skispringen.

Stan kann Francine im Bett nicht mehr glücklich machen, weshalb sie Besuch vom Poltergasmus bekommt. Nun müssen sie den Geist wieder loswerden. Roger bittet das Medium Zelda Rubinstein um Hilfe. Hayley bringt unterdessen ihren Freund mit nach Hause.

Steve möchte seinem Vater endlich beweisen, dass er kein kleiner Junge mehr ist, und begleitet ihn und seine CIA-Freunde zu ihrem jährlichen Jagdausflug. Roger und Klaus machen unterdessen einen Roadtrip.

Francine will Steve beweisen, dass sie eine lässige Mutter ist, und bringt ihm deshalb ein paar Tricks beim Ladendiebstahl bei. Allerdings wird Steve erwischt und zur Strafe in einen Sweatshop in Venezuela geschickt.
Aus einem Ausflug, bei dem die Familie Weihnachtslichter bewundern will, wird eine Rettungsaktion.
Tina übernimmt als ganz neue Kummerkastentante die Ratgeberkolumne der Schulzeitung.

Bei einem Aufenthalt im Spa-Hotel läuft Bubbles de Vere in ihren Ex-Mann und seine junge Freundin. Lou und Andy machen einen Ausflug zu einem Aquarium. Dudley hat sich eine Braut aus Thailand bestellt, doch sie sieht nicht aus wie im Katalog. Vicky und ihre Gang werden von einer anderen Gruppe zu einem Dance-Battle herausgefordert. Daffyd will sich als Callboy versuchen, doch die Anfragen behagen ihm überhaupt nicht.

Andy und Lou nehmen an einer Spielshow teil, ob sie wohl viele Preise abräumen werden? Vicky Pollard hat endlich einen neuen Job gefunden. Sie arbeitet jetzt bei einer Sex-Hotline. Don und Pat erleben Merkwürdiges im indischen Restaurant. Daffyd glaubt an seine Homosexualität, will aber dennoch eine Freundin haben. Denn er hat ja keine andere Wahl.
Unbegreifliche Mächte des Bösen zwingen Hayley, einen Space Jam zu machen.
Stan versucht, ewig zu leben, um alle Punkte auf seiner Bucketlist abzuarbeiten.

Stan ist weiterhin deprimiert, weil alles, was er sieht scheiße ist. Währenddessen wird in der Schule über das Asperger-Syndrom geredet und es stellt sich heraus, dass Stan dieses hat und er wird in eine Anstalt geschickt. Cartman will dieses auch und tut sich Burger in den Arsch (Ass Burgers) und hofft, keine Schule mehr zu haben, aber er kommt nicht durch. Als Kyle einen der Burger probiert und ihn lecker findet, gründen sie einen kleinen Laden vor Erics Haus.

Die vier frühreifen Grundschüler Eric Cartman, Stan Marsh, Kyle Broflovski und Kenny McCormick nehmen jede erdenkliche Randgruppe aufs Korn und verspotten Berühmtheiten wie Politiker und Reality-Stars auf ungeheuerlichste Weise.
Die Solars legen sich einen Dinosaurier als Haustier zu!
Es ist Yumyulacks Geburtstag!
Beavis und Butt-Head folgen Todd zu einer Party, um zu lernen, warum er so cool ist.
Als Beavis seinen Hintern verbrennt, muss er sich einer schmerzhaften Operation unterziehen.

Nachdem Beavis zu einem Kampf herausgefordert wird, trainiert Butt-Head ihn zum Champion. Beavis und Butt-Head mittleren Alters glauben, dass ihre Spermien sie davon abhalten, zu punkten, und beschließen, sich einer Vasektomie zu unterziehen.

Rick ist ein leicht gestörter Alkoholiker mit einer großen wissenschaftlichen Begabung. Er ist seit kurzer Zeit wieder mit seiner Familie zusammen und unternimmt mit Enkel Morty Ausflüge in den Weltraum, was nicht gut für Mortys Schulkarriere ist.
Rick hat vergessen, den Ölstand zu prüfen und nun muss das Auto repariert werden.

Veteran police detective Roger Murtaugh is only days away from retiring when he and his tough partner, Martin Riggs, are roped into an important internal affairs case. Working with the beautiful, no-nonsense Sergeant Lorna Cole and aided by the shifty informant Leo Getz, Murtaugh and Riggs begin to close in on a black-market weapons operation involving corrupt cop and arms dealer Jack Travis.

At her grandmother's funeral, Phoebe is astounded to meet her biological father, Frank Sr, who she has been trying to find for years. Elsewhere, Chandler tells perfectionist Monica that she is useless at massage, and Joey's fondness for an expensive bag loses him an audition.
Chandler and Monica's relationship becomes less of a secret, and Ross must prove to his boss that he's sane in order to return to work.

Chandler becomes anxious when he thinks Monica wants more from their relationship, and Ross moves into his new flat and fails to impress his new neighbours. Meanwhile, Joey is afraid to end his relationship with a diminutive woman who punches him hard every time she thinks something is fun.
Phoebe finds a police officer's badge and goes on a spree of arrests until she meets up with the owner, while Joey wonders if he is in love with Monica.

Rachel has an interview for her dream job at Ralph Lauren. All goes well until she inadvertently kisses the interviewer, and at the second interview she mistakenly berates him for his `sexual intentions'. Meanwhile, Monica competes to have a better relationship than Phoebe's, and Joey is arrested for stalking a sexy neighbour with whom Ross gets a date.

Rachel's new boss and colleague both smoke. When Rachel discovers that they make business decisions without her in the smoking room, she pretends to be a serious smoker so she can be part of the discussion. Meanwhile, Ross's son and Joey audition for the same commercial, but only one of them can get the part.
Ross really likes the pretty pizza-delivery woman, but his flirting technique is awful. Meanwhile, a nasty surprise awaits Joey when he tells everyone about his big television appearance.
The gang are enjoying a ride in Phoebe's boyfriend's cop car until a gunshot rings out. Also, Rachel overhears a telephone message for Ross.

After Gary confides in Monica that he intends to ask Phoebe to move in with him, Monica immediately breaks her promise to him and tells Phoebe, who worries that it is too early in the relationship. She persuades Chandler to talk to Gary, hoping that Chandler's fear of commitment will rub off on him, but Gary's enthusiasm overwhelms even Chandler.
Joey's first major film role leads to an unexpected experience in Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Phoebe can't quite remember why she hates Ross.
The gang travel to Las Vegas, Nevada, where more than one surprise awaits them. After Ross misinterprets Rachel's actions, a war of public humiliation results.
The gang are having fun in Las Vegas, where Monica and Chandler get lucky, Rachel makes Ross regret playing a prank on her, and Joey schemes for fame and fortune.

Everyone is toasting Chandler and Monica's engagement, but after Chandler fails to come up with the goods in the bedroom, he begins to worry about the consequences. Elsewhere, Monica thinks Rachel is trying to steal her glory when she catches her kissing Ross.

Monica's dream of a fairytale wedding fizzles out after she learns what her parents have done with her wedding fund. Meanwhile, Rachel fumes when a teasing Joey stumbles across her juicy late-night reading material.

Chandler's desperate effort to bond with Monica's dad by playing racquetball backfires when he accidentally gets too up-close-and-personal. Elsewhere, Rachel tries to teach 'landlubber' Joey how to sail without falling overboard, while Monica seeks to replicate Phoebe's late grandmother's secret recipe by deconstructing her last remaining cookie.

Rachel must hire an assistant and agonises over whether to hire an efficient, experienced woman, or sexy young Tag Jones. Ignoring her friends' advice, she hires Tag and soon regrets it. To make matters worse, Tag is attracted to Phoebe.

While taking an engagement picture for himself and Monica, Chandler can't stop pulling a strange face, Rachel enlists Joey to take Tag out for a night on the town, and Phoebe and Ross date a couple in the middle of a divorce.

Wedding fever continues when Monica can't decide whether to appoint Rachel or Phoebe as her maid of honour. To help Monica decide, Joey and Ross test them on how they would react in certain wedding situations.

Ross is elated that the university library contains his doctoral dissertation, but he is shocked to discover that it is located in a remote corner frequently used by students having sex. Elsewhere, the tables are turned on Joey when Erin is the one to just want sex and not a relationship.

Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during Thanksgiving dinner, and Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a cute dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away.

Rachel is dating her assistant, Tag, but they must keep it a secret at work because of the company's anti-dating policy. Her friends warn her that the relationship will only cause her trouble, but just for fun, she becomes more brazen about it.
Ross finds himself looking after Ben and decides to do something special. Since all the Santa costumes have been rented out, Ross dons the holiday armadillo outfit.
Mr Bean has a grand day at the hairdresser's, enters Teddy in a pet show and has to find his way off a train when he loses his ticket.

Mr Bean goes to a swimming pool but finds himself terrified of the high diving board, afterwards, he must try several imaginative ways to get out of the car park when he doesn't have enough money to pay. He then demonstrates the proper way to make a sandwich whilst out at the park. Finally, when Mr Bean and his girlfriend go on a date to watch a horror movie he teases her for being scared until the film actually starts.

Mr Bean buys a portable television but can't get it to work properly. Then, when his camera is stolen, he must identify the suspect in a police line-up. Afterwards, he attends a magic show and disco with his girlfriend but ends up embarrassing her.
Mr Bean rushes to the dentist's office after oversleeping, then helps a boy fix his remote-controlled toy boat, and later is menaced by a wasp while having a picnic.

pr.t: Ed Stafford: Wie ich die Welt überlebte
pr.d: Borneo ist die drittgrößte Insel der Welt und zu großen Teilen mit tropischem Regenwald bedeckt. Survival-Profi Ed Stafford will es zehn Tage in dieser grünen Hölle aushalten, bei Temperaturen um die 40 Grad Celsius und einer Luftfeuchtigkeit von 90 Prozent. Über Wassermangel kann er sich auf dem Eiland nicht beklagen, doch dem ehemaligen Soldaten machen die lästigen Moskitos zu schaffen und eine entzündete Wunde am Fuß.

A disaster of a 1975 Corvette has been sitting in a Police Officer's garage for 15 years. The Garage Squad will try to get this Corvette back in high speed pursuit.

A group of friends from high school spent their youth wrenching on Mopars. Now young men, they are back together with the Squad to rescue a 1971 Dodge Dart.

Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid and looks at whether this underwater monster is the legendary kraken.

Rick will sich neues Land sichern, seine Mitarbeiter kämpfen sich in 14-Stunden-Schichten Meter für Meter ins Erdreich vor, und sie verbessern eine Straße, um den Betrieb effizienter zu machen. Noch ist ungewiss, ob sich all das am Ende auszahlen wird.

Mrs Patmore, Daisy and Andy help Mr Mason to move into Yew Tree Farm and Andy finds an unexpected confidant in Thomas. Mary and Tom go to watch Henry Talbot test drive a new car, but Mary is not convinced she has met her match.

Opinions are divided above and below stairs when Tom and Mary open Downton Abbey to the public for a day in aid of the hospital. Headmaster Mr Dawes has a proposition for Mr Molesley and Baxter is thrown into turmoil when she receives an unexpected letter. Plans for the hospital takeover are not fully resolved, and battle lines are drawn between Cora and Violet. Carson has an axe to grind with Thomas, but all is not as it appears.

Henry Talbot invites the Crawleys to watch him motor racing at Brooklands, but events leave Mary reeling. Violet makes a plan which surprises the family and delights Denker, and also gets to the bottom of Amelia Cruikshank's curious show of friendship towards Isobel. Mr Molesley and Daisy must rise to the challenge on examination day, while Mrs Patmore and Mrs Hughes teach Mr Carson a lesson. Andy's secret is brought to light, and Thomas feels increasingly isolated.

Barnaby investigates a death which looks like suicide. The dead man was a troubled and depressed gambler on a losing streak, but Barnaby's nose tells him to look for a murderer and then recognises someone from his past, in the shape of Dr Jane Moore.

Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

James' adventure begins on the Orkney islands, a place he's never been and is excited to explore. He's joined by top Scottish chef and good friend Nick Nairn. James takes to the skies to visit North Ronaldsay where the people are outnumbered by sheep, and cooks up some lamb chops.

England are back in action in the Nations League, and take on Spain at the Wanda Metropolitano, the home of ⚽ [LaLiga] Atletico Madrid. The two teams met back in September where the World Champions ran out 3-2 winners at Wembley. Since then England have played well including a 7-0 away win against Croatia and are now in line for a top two finish in the group stage, and are on track for the knockout rounds of the Nations League in March.
The latest national and international news.

Mass accommodation sites are central to the government's plan to end the use of asylum hotels. This undercover investigation goes inside Crowborough, a former military training camp now housing asylum seekers. Filming covertly, the programme investigates conditions inside the site, finding how systemically poor welfare checks are having serious consequences. The film also examines the local community's response to asylum seekers being housed in the town, including a network of surveillance set up by local groups to monitor the camp's residents whenever they leave the site. It also looks at instances of intimidation towards people helping the new arrivals.

Ex-lovers fight over a loan, the price on an evangelist's seminar causes a rift between sisters, and a teen is accused of damaging a car with a paintball gun.

A man attains his dream car, a Subaru STI, because his girlfriend puts the loan in her name. She later sues for associated vehicle costs; he claims she stole $3,000 from him. Starting an apartment fire with a hookah pipe is the accusation laid against a woman by two of her ex-roommates. An incriminating text message comes back to haunt her.
When Blaire's Instagram lover Markie broke her heart, she moved on. But now Markie is back and wants to meet. Blaire needs Nev and Max's help to make it happen and reveal Markie's secret. (S4, ep14)
A woman is accused of selling belongings without permission, and ex-flatmates sue each other for unpaid rent and missing property.
A woman is accused of selling heroin to a former addict, a woman says her ex-lover took possessions.
Jarrod never thought he'd find love until he fell for Abby on Facebook. Jarrod thinks Abby could be "the one", but she's refusing to see him. What is Abby hiding? (S1, ep5)

A rare Egyptian cat is allegedly killed by a pit bull after accidentally being let out of the house. The pet's owner sues for damages and unpaid rent. A teenager insists that her ex-boyfriend owes for a $300 loan to buy car parts.
A landlady sues tenants for assault, and damages, and a man says his ex-flatmate assaulted him and vandalised his car.
Michael convinced Romeo to move to Atlanta to pursue their dream of being together. Now Romeo's in Atlanta but Michael still won't meet up! Nev and Kamie help track Michael down! (S8, ep53)
A young former couple fight over the payment of traffic tickets, and a chef is sued for loans.
After a magic school mishap, the Charmed Ones must prevent the murder of the infamous Lady Godiva, and Phoebe has doubts about new guy Leslie's writing qualifications.
Dr Adil Sheraz treats a bus driver with over 100 lipomas, Dr Toby Nelson tries to help a 23-year-old who's covered in keloids, plus a treat of a cyst for Dr Emma McMullen. (S5, ep8)

Grams puts a spell on the brothers to end their rivalry, but the spell turns the Charmed Ones into bickering teens; Leo consults a demonic seer (Charisma Carpenter) to find out who is behind the attack on Wyatt.
In Thailand, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) joins a group of mercenaries in war-torn Burma, and rescue a group of Christian aid workers who were kidnapped by the ruthless local infantry unit. (2008)
Paige encounters a cursed 18th-century pirate, Leslie finds ways to spend more time with Phoebe, and a federal agent begins investigating the Halliwells.
The Charmed Ones have to answer to the Angel of Death when they inadvertently cast a spell that stops people dying, and Phoebe's feelings for Leslie deepen.
With suspicion surrounding Leo, the girls are assigned a new whitelighter. Federal Agent Brody warns Paige of a new threat, while Phoebe and Leslie confess their true feelings.
Lucille led a simple life until she was asked to work for music producer Kidd Cole. Companies were never paid, and one day Kidd couldn't be found. She searches for some answers.
Mama doesn't always know best. Shuntay enlists the help of Nev and Max after her mum begins talking about marriage and uprooting her family to be with a man who refuses to meet in person.

Courtney has been mad in love with her Turkish boyfriend for 3 years, but she met Chris role-playing and is wondering if he's just a fantasy? Nev and Kamie cross digital borders to hunt the identity of her international mystery man.

When pretty teenager Bella Swan moves to small town Forks, Washington, it is not long before the boys notice her. On her first day of school, Bella's heart is lost to brooding loner Edward Cullen. He seems disinterested until, in a move that defies the laws of physics, he saves her from an accident in the car park. Now even more smitten, Bella pesters him with questions until he admits that he is a vampire.

The tattooing titans come to the rescue of Luke, whose drunken tatt got him into bother back home, and Mark, whose belly-based Buddha has left him a laughingstock. Alice removes Hannah's hashtag tattoo.

Eine unbescholtene Frau landet in einem Paradies, das sich für sie in ein nasses Grab verwandelt - aber dieses Wasser verwischt nicht alle wichtigen Spuren. Außerdem sorgt der Tod eines geliebten Gemeindemitglieds für große Fragezeichen.

Der Mann einer erschossenen Frau wird beschuldigt, für ihren Tod verantwortlich zu sein. Er behauptet jedoch, sie habe Selbstmord begangen. Ein Polizist muss sich vor Gericht für den Tod seiner eigenen Ehefrau verantworten.

Kenneth Maxwell erblickt ein brennendes Haus und ruft die Feuerwehr. Doch als die eintrifft, sind Kenneth und zwei weitere Personen, die sich im Haus befanden, tot. Drei Frauenleichen werden in der Tampa Bay in Florida gefunden.

Ein geständiger Kleinkrimineller verschwindet nach seiner Aussage wie vom Erdboden. Seine Kumpanen verdächtigen einen Polizisten des Mordes an ihrem Freund. Nach einem tödlichen Unfall soll eine Video-Animation einen Verdächtigen überführen.
In realen Untersuchungen greifen Experten auf forensische Wissenschaft zurück, um mysteriöse Verbrechen und andere Rätsel zu lösen.

Kaye lebt mit ihrem Sohn zusammen. Eines Nachts klopft ein Mann an ihre Tür und möchte das Telefon benutzen. Als sie ablehnt, verschwindet der Mann, kommt aber kurze Zeit später wieder und bricht bei ihr ein.

Ein Polizist aus Alaska findet in einem öffentlichen Park die Leiche einer Frau. Die Tatwaffe wird in 3.000 Kilometer Entfernung gefunden. 1993 entgleist ein Zug. Die Ermittler wollen herausfinden, ob es sich dabei um eine Sabotage handelt.

Vor 20 Jahren wurde Keith Milner des Mordes an dem achtjährigen Tommy Lewis verdächtigt. Aus Mangel an Beweisen musste die Polizei den Drogenabhängigen damals freilassen. Die wütenden Bewohner der Stadt vertrieben Milner, doch nun ist er mit seiner schwangeren Frau zurückgekehrt. Die Einwohner scheinen seine vermeintliche Schuld an Tommys Tod nicht vergessen zu haben. Ein Unbekannter hat ihm die Kehle durchgeschnitten.

Goren und Eames gehen dem Mord an einer bekannten Atheistin nach. Diese wurde zusammen mit ihrer Enkelin, April, entführt. Im Gegensatz zu ihrer Großmutter gelang der Enkelin die Flucht. Im Laufe der Ermittlungen werden zwei der drei Kidnapper ermordet aufgefunden. Eine weitere Spur bringt die Detektive zu Aprils Masseur, der mit seiner Kundin offenbar eine engere Beziehung hat. Stecken beide womöglich unter einer Decke?

Vicky, eine junge Frau, die sich in ihrer Freizeit um Obdachlose kümmert, wird tot aufgefunden. Offensichtlich wurde sie auf der Suche nach einem ihrer Schützlinge ermordet. Goren und Eames finden heraus, dass es weitere Opfer gibt.

Goren und Eames wollen einen Mann hinter Gitter bringen, der seine Familie tyrannisiert und seiner schwer selbstmordgefährdeten Frau, Doreen, keine Beachtung schenkt. Allerdings reichen die Beweise nicht aus.

Meisterdieb Wesley wird gefasst. Ihm wird neben dem Diebstahl kostbarer Silberlöffel auch der Mord an einer Spezialistin eines Auktionshauses vorgeworfen. Als eine große Menge Geld gefunden wird, scheint klar, wer der Dieb ist.

Dem schwerbehinderten Star-Physiker John Manotti und seinem Assistenten Carl Neminger ist ein Durchbruch in der Quantenphysik gelungen. Kurz bevor die beiden ihre neue Theorie der Öffentlichkeit vorstellen können, wird Neminger ermordet aufgefunden.

Seit Monaten gehen in River Tower, einem noblen Wohnhaus am Ufer des Hudson, eigenartige Dinge vor sich. Der Beton bröselt, aus den Wänden kommt Dampf und die Fenster sind undicht. Als einer der Bewohner mit einer Kreissäge ermordet wird, schalten sich Goren und Eames ein. Kindermädchen Ann Marie sieht die Ereignisse als Plagen, die Gott den Menschen gesandt hat. Sie ist sich dessen sicher, weil Gott per E-Mail in Kontakt mit ihr tritt, um ihr Aufträge zu erteilen.

Die junge Allison wird erschlagen in einem Müllcontainer aufgefunden. Die sehr vage Spur führt zu einem Mann, der seit vielen Jahren auf der Flucht zu sein scheint. Akribisch verschleiert er seine Identität und ist seinen Verfolgern immer einen Schritt voraus.
Die Prostituierte Jocelyn wird tot in einem Sarg liegend aufgefunden. Es scheint, ihr letzter Freier habe mit ihr obskure Fantasien ausgelebt. Die Spur führt Goren und Eames in einen Vampirclub.

Kurz bevor Gefängniswärter Taylor Kenna seinen neuen Job als Feuerwehrmann antreten kann, wird er ermordet. Seine Kollegen aus dem Gefängnis halten sich bei den Befragungen durch Goren und Eames bedeckt. Dennoch finden die beiden heraus, dass einige der Insassen nirgendwo registriert sind. Ein Geheimnis, das Kenna und nun auch Goren und Eames zum Verhängnis werden soll.

Der Männermagazin-Herausgeber und Lebemann George Merritt versteigert sein Notizbuch. Darin enthalten sind die Namen, Telefonnummern und Vorlieben seiner vor allem weiblichen Bekannten. Den Zuschlag für das Notizbuch erhält Lila Parson. Tags darauf wird sie ermordet aufgefunden. Goren und Eames finden Indizien, dass der Politiker Jim Radcliff einst häufig in Swingerclubs verkehrte und Interesse am Verschwinden von Beweisen haben könnte.

Josh und Beatrice sind aufgeregt, denn die stadtbekannte Gastronomie-Kritikerin Sally Moore stattet ihrem Lokal einen Besuch ab. Als diese jedoch tot aufgefunden wird und Josh spurlos verschwunden ist, beginnt für die Ermittler ein schwieriger Fall.

Manuel Schmitt ist begeisterter Hobby-Tuner. Seinen Renault Clio hat er mit Flammen verziert, die Karosserie gereinigt und ein Gewindefahrwerk eingebaut - selbst an Karosseriearbeiten hat er sich versucht. Doch der Wagen steht nun bereits seit einigen Jahren vor seiner Wohnung und gammelt vor sich hin. Manuel fehlt nicht nur die Zeit, sondern auch die technische Umsetzung ist nicht immer perfekt. Jetzt sollen die Tuning-Profis den Renault retten.

Die beiden Moderatoren Andreas und Alexander präsentieren in der Sendung relevante Themen rund ums Auto und Mobilität. Zum Spezialisten-Team gehören auch der Profi-Rennfahrer Lance D. Arnold sowie der Testchef Albert Königshausen.

Claus, Ralle und Ralf bekommen den Auftrag, eine trostlose Wiese innerhalb von sieben Tagen in einen blühenden Garten umzugestalten. Zusammen sind sie die `Beets-Brüder'. Der Garten ist jedoch kein Problem, sondern nur eine Herausforderung.

Diesmal stellen sich Jasna Fritzi Bauer, die Ehrlich Brothers und Chris Tall dem anspruchsvollen Kochwettkampf. Um die strenge Jury zu überzeugen, setzen sie auf kulinarische Raffinesse und Improvisationstalent. Wird das ausreichen?

Jedes Jahr kommen neue Produkte auf den Markt. Detlef Steves und seine Frau Nicole sowie weitere wechselnde Familien nehmen Erfindungen aus aller Welt genau unter die Lupe. Dabei werden das Design, der Nutzwert und der Preis bewertet.

Ein Highschool-Lehrer verschwindet spurlos und hinterlässt seiner Frau und Freund Briefe. Darin schreibt er, dass er einen radikalen Neuanfang beginnen will. Die Ermittlungen erweisen sich ohne Leiche als sehr schwierig.

Addison kommt Kevin wieder näher und erhält gleichzeitig ein Jobangebot von Charlotte im Krankenhaus, was sie aufgrund der angespannten Stimmung in der Oceanside Wellness Group tatsächlich in Betracht zieht.

Nach einer Spendengala wird ein Strafverteidiger plötzlich ermordet aufgefunden. Als das CPD ermittelt, finden sie sich in der Welt der Wahlkampffinanzierung wieder. Was sie dort erfahren, lässt sie den Bürgermeisterkandidaten mit neuen Augen sehen.

Das Team des CPD ist auf der Jagd nach einem Heroinlieferanten und kann ihn schnappen. Dabei stoßen sie jedoch auch auf einen verurteilten Verbrecher. Der wurde kurz zuvor wegen eines Verfahrensfehlers entlassen. Nun sitzt er wieder ein.

Michael Meyer möchte sich eine günstige und eine teure Wohnung ansehen. Dabei wird er von einem Freund begleitet, der selber Makler war. Die Berliner Maklerin Britta Gruttmann will die teure Wohnung verkaufen und macht ihm die günstigere schlecht.

Die Maklerin Iris Gehring ist dieses Mal für einen Auftrag in Hannover unterwegs. Eine Tochter aus gutem Hause sucht ihre erste eigene Wohnung - bezahlt von ihrem Vater. Doch keine Wohnung scheint für sie gut genug zu sein.

Aniza und Cocoi sind zwei Freundinnen mit großem Verwöhn-Anspruch. Robert Neubauer soll ihnen eine Super-WG beschaffen. Eigentlich hatte er der Besichtigung mit Freude entgegengesehen, aber die Damen haben keinen Sinn für einen Hahn im Korb.

Enie van de Meiklokjes verschönert gemeinsam mit dem Bauprofi Mark Kühler deutsche Wohnungen. Die gelernte Dekorateurin und der gelernte Maurermeister schauen sich genau an, was umsetzbar ist. Das Thema lautet diesmal "Pferdeflüsterinnen".

Dominik bezahlt Unterhalt für seine Tochter. Weil sie mit ihrer Mutter angeblich nach Griechenland gezogen ist, hat er sie noch nicht zu Gesicht bekommen. Als er der Mutter gegenübersteht, kommen in Dominik einige Zweifel auf.

Nach acht Monaten unverschuldeter Arbeitslosigkeit hat der 46-jährige Bademeister Ralf Dörfler endlich ein attraktives Jobangebot bekommen. Damit sollten dann auch die finanziellen Probleme seiner Familie der Vergangenheit angehören. Doch statt einfach seiner Arbeit nachgehen zu können, muss er sich den ständigen sexuellen Übergriffen seiner Vorgesetzten Claudia erwehren. Plötzlich steht nicht nur sein Job auf dem Spiel, sondern auch seine Ehe.

In Recklinghausen findet der Hausmeister Gunnar Paschulke einen neuen Job. Für die Mieter des Gebäudes ist von nun an der Spaß am Wohnen vorbei. Gunnar terrorisiert die Familien und schreckt nicht davor zurück, zweifelhafte Methoden anzuwenden.

Franz Krüger erwischt seine Frau Melanie mit seinem Vorgesetzten Peter Schulz und schlägt ihn im Affekt. Melanie und ihr Geliebter zeigen ihn wegen schwerer Körperverletzung an, weil Schulz angeblich seitdem auf einem Auge blind ist. Franz Krüger wird daraufhin zur Bewährung verurteilt. Doch Melanie Krüger setzt alles daran, Franz ins Gefängnis zu bringen. Sie schreckt auch nicht vor einer Intrige zurück, in die sie ihre Tochter verwickelt.

Verwirrt wacht die 19-jährige Nora Fuchs in einem Park auf. Von der vorangegangenen Nacht fehlt jede Erinnerung. Es häufen sich Hinweise, dass ihr Bekannter Alex Wichert sie mit K.-o.-Tropfen betäubt und vergewaltigt hat, aber die Beweise fehlen.
