Bind, torture, kill - fesseln, quälen, töten. Auf diese grausame Art und Weise ermordete der selbsternannte BTK-Killer zwischen 1974 und 1991 zehn Menschen. Darunter auch zwei Kinder. 2005 wird der Familienvater Dennis Rader für die Verbrechen verurteilt. Bereits als Kind gab es Anzeichen für Dennis dunkle Seite. Er hatte brutale und schockierende Fantasien, die in Mordlust endeten.

Am 01.11.2011 geht der Hausmeister Larry Jakel gegen 23 Uhr einer Beschwerde nach. Er bekam einen Anruf, dass es in einer der Wohnungen komisch riechen würde. Als er die Wohnung von James O'Mara betritt, findet er etwas Grausames vor. Larry ist schnell klar, dass der Mann auf dem Sofa tot ist. Als die Polizisten eintreffen, können sie feststellen, dass James erschossen wurde. Wer hat ihm das bloß angetan und warum musste er sterben?

Julene und Jeremy Simko führen ein ruhiges Leben auf dem Land - weit abseits der städtischen Hektik. Doch eines Tages wird Jeremy erschossen. Seine Frau spricht von Einbrechern. Doch die Polizei findet Unterlagen in den Papieren der Eheleute.

Der Vater und Ehemann Leon Baucham wird tot von Spaziergängern in einem Gebüsch gefunden. Die Ermittler landen bei ihren Mordermittlungen bei der Mutter seiner Ehefrau. Die Hinweise verdichten sich, dass sie etwas damit zu tun hat.

Paul Rudd and Steve Coogan -the kings of comedy come together for this must-see film. A big screen match made in heaven in this poignant and endearing comedy as they play a bickering, and flamboyant, couple (with an extensive erotic film collection) whose lavish life is thrown in to turmoil with the sudden appearance of their long-lost grandson. Will the pair be able to take on this new challenge?

Mini-series based on the sci-fi movie about a cyborg police officer. RoboCop stumbles across a cult whose members worship him as a god, but is tricked into believing he is a mere human - leaving him vulnerable to attack by the RoboHunters. Starring Page Fletcher

Romantic comedy spoof starring Alyson Hannigan and Adam Campbell. Julia Jones's parents would like her to settle down with a nice boy who shares her Greek-African-American-Indian-Japanese heritage. But Julia has her sights set on wet-but-handsome Englishman Grant Funkyerdoder, who has no idea what he's letting himself in for.

Comedy starring Spencer Tracy, Joan Bennett and Elizabeth Taylor. Stanley Banks is looking forward to some peace and quiet now that his daughter is married. But his plans are disrupted when she announces that she is going to have a baby.

Three days before their wedding, Jess and Max are about to call it off. However, Jess begins to question her decision when Max's brother enlists the help of Billie to save the wedding, and in the process starts to fall for her. Romantic drama, starring Jocelyn Hudon, Jake Foy and Sam Robert Muik

Romantic fantasy starring Claire Coffee and Ryan McPartlin. Young executive Holly Maddux wakes after a fall to find that the hunky mannequin she admired in a department store window has come to life and is by her side. Love blossoms, but Holly soon discovers that being perfect all the time is hard work.

Disaster movie starring Maximilian Schell and Diane Baker. Tension is mounting aboard the Batavia Queen as it sails towards Krakatoa, a volcanic island near Java that's about to become the site of one of the biggest natural catastrophes ever recorded.

Comedy sequel starring Martin Lawrence and Nia Long. FBI agent Malcolm Turner once again goes under cover, this time to expose the suspected designer of a dangerous computer worm. Re-assuming the disguise of chubby grandma Big Momma, he infiltrates the man's family by posing as a nanny. But crime busting isn't easy when you've got endless household chores and three energetic kids to control.

A lecturer discovers he has six months to live, and resolves to use the time he has left to the fullest, railing against authority and embracing a newfound hedonistic lifestyle. As the reality of his impending demise sinks in, he resolves to make amends for past mistakes and do what he can for the people who have supported him. Comedy drama, starring Johnny Depp, Rosemarie DeWitt and Odessa Young.
